tips: Drink water regularly through the day, especially in hot or humid weather.
Wash your hands with soap for at least 20 seconds, especially before eating and after using the toilet.
Aim for a short daily walk. Regular movement supports heart health and mood.
Take medicines exactly as your doctor prescribed and ask a pharmacist if you are unsure.
Keep a list of your medicines and allergies with you in case of an emergency.
Try to keep regular sleep and wake times, even on weekends.
Pause for a few slow breaths when you feel stressed. Small breaks help.
Eat a variety of fruit, vegetables and whole grains, and go easy on salt and sugar.
Use sunscreen, a hat or shade when outdoors in strong sun, and avoid peak midday heat.
If you or someone near you has chest pain, trouble breathing or signs of a stroke, call 112 immediately.
